edges.reason: Launch proof is invalid while producer reads can cross the transaction byte ceiling.
Authenticated template screens cannot retain unbounded reads of embedding-bearing authoring rows.
Launch proof must include a hard relation CPU and tag-cardinality bound.
Recipient-page traffic cannot retain growing duplicate scans that bypass the public-discovery cache.
Every cookie-bearing request cannot hydrate a wide mutable profile or depend on a database clock before serving any route.
Campaign navigation cannot rebuild verification, analytics, and debate state from every historical action on each request.
Every authenticated organization route cannot inherit unrelated history scans from a shared layout megafetch.
Anonymous recipient and debate traffic cannot enumerate every historical argument or paginate only after a full collection.
A free API key cannot receive unlimited reads or rewrite its authentication row on every request before endpoint work.
Anonymous catalogs, published artifacts, and live polls cannot retain whole-table collections or sub-K disclosure.
A single supporter page or export batch cannot reread ten thousand encrypted people and expand an unbounded tag join.
Coalition detail and API traffic cannot reconstruct every member supporter, action, receipt, and bill history per request.

A shared-Free launch cannot publish while either deployment still registers recurring jobs or retains active durable work; cancellation cannot stand in for completion of an already-running action, and no deployment may cross resume until the provider-audit-backed pause epoch, both bounded inventories, and every reachable-root bound are clean.
Profile receipts and organization scorecards cannot traverse supporter, action, delivery, and receipt history through per-row collections.
An enabled API request cannot rebuild ten-thousand-row windows, hydrate embedding-bearing documents, or multiply the organization budget by minting keys.
An organization event cannot expand into an unbounded number of delivery rows or target untrusted private-network destinations.
A compose, count, or dispatch transaction cannot scan an entire sparse audience or rebuild the same ten-thousand-recipient cohort for every batch.
Explicit network and representative pages cannot reintroduce unbounded limits, whole-follow collections, or per-card roster joins after the shared shell is fixed.
A routine plan check cannot synchronously repair itself by reading tens of thousands of historical action and blast rows.
Finite configuration, operator trace replay, and outcome summaries cannot retain unenforced cardinality or rebuild workflow, donation, and SMS history on each request.
Profile and recipient traffic cannot scan credential or relation history, return ambiguous ground state, or cache a time-sensitive credential decision past expiry.
Email quota cannot be a check-then-send race, and an uncertain carrier acceptance cannot become a silent release or blind resend.
A global STOP or complaint cannot lose to a stale organization cohort, and SMS cannot reach Twilio without durable per-recipient linearization or a non-overridable launch hold.
Analytics cannot accept abuse-amplifiable raw writes or publish a differential-privacy claim without durable sensitivity, budget, noise, and cleanup evidence.
A migration, seed, cleanup, audit, or operator request cannot replace bounded serving reads with an unbounded maintenance transaction or silently skipped cursor range.
Launch proof must establish refresh urgency, cache-cost, and crash-recovery invariants.

Launch proof is invalid if anonymous readiness can trigger dependency I/O or the exact-SHA readiness, source-setting, exhaustive-inventory, and post-upload reconciliation mechanisms can fail open; live reviewed-SHA promotion remains gated by PD-00, PD-50, and PD-70.
Launch proof must include a trusted-generated, binding-free, zero-dependency containment path without conflating that bootstrap with normal application readiness.

Normal launch cannot expose Pages directly or through a stale alias/overlapping Access app, drift runtime flags, accept a reusable/JWT-only origin credential, serve provisional or unproved post-C release authority, split cache ownership, stampede cold origin, cache personalized variants, depend on purge, retain stale landing content without a ceiling, or claim external Access/topology state from source tests.
Paid public actions cannot remain an unauthenticated cost-amplification surface, and a failed Queue handoff cannot silently preserve stale landing authority beyond its bounded publication window.

Launch cannot rely on cache, point-in-time Convex or Queue Free receipts, or estimated Pages/Queue weights alone: team-global admission layers preserve the reviewed nominal slices, while full normal release remains blocked until live phase proofs plus paid/no-shared-hard-disable or quota-isolation authority close duplicate delivery, browser-direct, native, and sibling-project gaps.

A cold discovery corpus cannot make every normal release unbounded, bypass Access, hide a transient Queue producer outside signed authority, or leave an orphaned exact-path Worker after timeout or cancellation.
Legacy rows must preserve projection correctness before adversarial verification.
Only a SHA that closes every foundational launch gate may enter exact-SHA release verification.
An emergency artifact cannot be trusted unless trusted generation, interception, no-I/O readiness, mode authorization, forward recovery, and prune ordering fail closed in executable proof.
Containment is an external production mutation and requires the exact reviewed context even though it deliberately does not require Convex readiness.
Convex billing reactivation cannot begin before frontend containment and both exact deployments are paused; queued scheduled jobs run on resume.

Neither deployment may resume until provider audit plus current-state fences prove a resume-free user-pause epoch, in-progress actions have completion/support evidence, the reviewed contained SHA is deployed while paused, and exact cron plus indexed active-work inventories are clean; the post-resume proof must show exact running state.
Only the verified exact SHA may become the backend producer.
The schema/functions and one-time compact manifest-authority activation must exist, with ready/matching byte-bound proof, before materialization or any Pages producer/readiness traffic.
Direct smoke needs a committed ready snapshot revision.
Frontend upload is held until bounded backend reads are observed.

FND-35D supplies the source-enforced trusted-edge, Access-safe adapter, terminal-ledger, cache, and rollback mechanisms. PD-50 itself holds frontend promotion until live Access/topology/secrets, denial, candidate, post-C, cache, and normal-or-containment rollback evidence is attached.

Warm only after the exact candidate, Access topology, trusted production edge, terminal C, distinct-capability uncached release-origin proof with origin stripping, health, hidden-origin denial, and post-upload inventory all pass.
Live observation begins after bounded landing-cache convergence, never before terminal authority.
